title: A Stranger Left $60 Million in Code — Was It Real or a Hoax?
description:
In 1820, a man named Thomas Beale checked into a Virginia hotel with two locked iron boxes and a story nobody could verify. He handed one box to the innkeeper, said the papers inside were written in cipher, and rode out — never to be seen again.

Decades later, one of three cipher sheets was cracked using the Declaration of Independence as a key. It revealed a vault containing over 2,900 pounds of gold, 5,100 pounds of silver, and jewels — worth more than $60 million today. The other two ciphers, which hide the exact location and the names of the men owed a share, remain unbroken after 150 years of attempts.

Now many believe Beale never existed at all — that the entire story was fabricated to sell pamphlets for fifty cents each. No treasure has ever been found, but people are still digging. Subscribe now 👇
